issue_name: Undisclosed account-data compromise and authentication-integrity incident (AURORA / NQ-17 / Trust Reset)
core_thesis: VistaPort experienced an undisclosed bulk-access/probable-exfiltration event against the legacy profile backup legacy_uap_backup_2021.tar.gz on 18-20 October 2025 (~912.8m records, ~286m active), plus forged session cookies from an unrotated VPAuth signing key. Management softened/reclassified the matter and the seller reps deny any material incident, while outside-counsel exposure ($240m-$465m) dwarfs the $12m reserve, insurance is likely unavailable, advertiser covenants create downside, and engagement decline undermines the synergy model. The buyer should reprice or take a large special indemnity/escrow.
recommended_action: Reduce purchase price by ~$400m OR require an equivalent ring-fenced special indemnity/escrow (~$400m-$500m) with bespoke cyber/privacy reps and extended survival; do not terminate.
expected_reasoning_steps: Identify anomalous bulk reads of the legacy_uap backup in SIEM / object-store logs (DR-067, DR-071).
Establish technical root cause: over-retained backup vs policy (DR-052/DR-073) and unrotated VPAuth signing key enabling cookie forging (DR-074/DR-065).
Contrast security framing (probable bulk access, DR-068/DR-069) with management's reclassification and sanitised final summary (DR-070/DR-060).
Surface the disclosure/governance contradiction vs the seller reps (DR-013/DR-086 vs DR-087).
Quantify exposure ($240m-$465m, DR-088) against the $12m reserve (DR-029/DR-018).
Identify insurance coverage weakness from late notice and prior-known-events exclusion (DR-081/DR-082/DR-030).
Trace advertiser contract covenants and early churn signals (DR-035/DR-046/DR-085/DR-033/DR-039/DR-036/DR-042).
Link engagement decline to the synergy model's unaffected-user assumption and its sensitivities (DR-048/DR-050/DR-099 vs DR-096/DR-023).
Recommend a quantified price reduction (~$400m) or equivalent escrow/indemnity, distinguishing the decoy issues.

decoy_explanations.DR-031: Sales/use tax nexus exposure ($6-9m) — real but an order of magnitude smaller and fully estimable.
decoy_explanations.DR-034: Search-partner concentration (~22% of search revenue) — a genuine concentration risk, not a value-destroying contingency.
decoy_explanations.DR-076: Email-gateway phishing/BEC noise — routine security operations, unrelated to the account-data incident.
decoy_explanations.DR-094: Executive/security retention plan — overlaps with attrition but is ordinary deal retention, not the issue itself.

analogy: Mirrors the Verizon/Yahoo repricing: an undisclosed historical account-data breach (incl. cookie forging) led to a ~$350m price cut and liability sharing on a ~$4.83bn deal rather than termination.
